## 리얼아머
### 0.1.5 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added armor stat source selection with server confirmation.
##### Fixed
* Fixed negative and percentage armor modifiers across equipped items.
* Fixed durability loss on Elytra and armor resistant to fire.
##### Changed
* Removed unverified version limits for optional NPC integrations.
##### Improved
* Improved setting availability when connected to older servers.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added configuration controls for the CustomNPCs resistance order.
#### Fabric 1.21.1 / Fabric 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed failed configuration saves reporting success instead of restoring previous values.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 & 26.3
##### Added
* Added Curios slot defense calculations for DNPC only, including body-part armor.

0.1.5 Change Log

Global

Added
  • Added armor stat source selection with server confirmation.
Fixed
  • Fixed negative and percentage armor modifiers across equipped items.
  • Fixed durability loss on Elytra and armor resistant to fire.
Changed
  • Removed unverified version limits for optional NPC integrations.
Improved
  • Improved setting availability when connected to older servers.

Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1

Added
  • Added configuration controls for the CustomNPCs resistance order.

Fabric 1.21.1 / Fabric 26.3

Fixed
  • Fixed failed configuration saves reporting success instead of restoring previous values.

Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 & 26.3

Added
  • Added Curios slot defense calculations for DNPC only, including body-part armor.
